question: What is the first and last name of each distinct artists who made a sculpture before 1900?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "artists" AS SELECT "artistid" AS "artistid", "fname" AS "fname", "lname" AS "lname", "birth_year" AS "birth_year", "deathyear" AS "deathyear" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "sculptures" AS SELECT "sculptureid" AS "sculptureid", "title" AS "title", "year" AS "year", "medium" AS "medium", "location" AS "location", "sculptorid" AS "sculptorid" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT DISTINCT a.fname AS first_name, a.lname AS last_name
FROM artists a
JOIN sculptures s
  ON s.sculptorid = a.artistid
WHERE s.year < 1900
ORDER BY last_name, first_name
